asset-explainer.coordinator-commands: A one-off instruction: write it here — it will be carried out, and the outcome moves to # History.
asset-explainer.coordinator-rules: Your standing instructions for the automation. Write here freely — it takes them into account.
asset-explainer.gates: Work stages. Tick an item — the next stage starts on its own.
asset-explainer.history: What has already happened. Filled in automatically.
asset-explainer.status-brief: What is happening now and what comes next. Written automatically.
asset-explainer.summary: A short description, and on a collection its counts. Written automatically — do not edit by hand.
gate-helper.build: tick to start the build from the approved plan
gate-helper.publish: tick to publish the tested build
gate-helper.rebuild: tick to rebuild: pull in new approvals and start the build again
gate-helper.review: tick to open review: the document re-enters the loop at the reviewer round
gate-helper.revise: tick to bring the document up to date with the approved documents it rests on, then open its review
gate-helper.start: tick to start the work the row names
gate-helper.write: tick to create the document and open its review
history.coherence-checked-trimmed: coherence check of {doc}: {count} conflict(s), {dropped} neighbour(s) dropped over the size budget
history.coherence-failed: WARNING: coherence check of {doc} (job {job_id}) delivered no usable result
history.coherence-trimmed: coherence check of {doc}: {count} neighbour(s) dropped over the size budget
history.deploy-failed: deploy to {target} failed with exit code {code} (log: {log})
history.job-dead: WARNING: coordinator job {job_id} ({trigger}) died — cleared the coordinator-job marker, asset NOT halted; a pending operator edit, if any, survives for the next genuine wake
history.stage-lag: WARNING: {doc} is still at draft after its {review_result} review — the coordinator did not promote it; not waking it again for this verdict
history.version-set: version set to {version} by the operator
upstream-explainer.actions: Operator decisions for this unit: tick one box — the next tick acts on it.
upstream-explainer.fetch-status: Result of the last scheduled fetch of this source repository.
upstream-explainer.history: Closed requests of this unit; lines are appended by the tick.
upstream-explainer.invalid-names: Source directories whose names are unsafe for the vault — no unit is created for them.
upstream-explainer.not-mirrored-current: Source files left out of the current mirror (source/): too large or not text. Judge the unit knowing these are absent.
upstream-explainer.not-mirrored-processe: Files that were absent from the last accepted snapshot (processed/) — the baseline drift is measured against.
upstream-explainer.units: Live summary of this source's units (Dataview).
upstream-root-note: _Mirrored external sources — one folder per configured source repo._
